outcome: side effects (fever, chills, joint pain, injection site inflammation, nausea, headache, body ache, dizziness)
adverse reactions (intrauterine fetal demise, spontaneous abortions)
cohort: Pregnant women from all three trimesters who received the Covishield vaccine at Vani Vilas Hospital, Bengaluru.
finding: Vaccination of pregnant women with the Covishield vaccine was found to be safe, with 40.30% experiencing side effects, primarily fever, within 4 weeks after the first dose.
